supersedes: the 2026-09-06T05:45:00Z revision, which named 60 rows for RETIRE. MEASURED AGAIN read-only against prod on 2026-09-06 for this PR: NONE of those 60 ids still exists. The fold and dedup lanes merged since (#1838, #1876) left 19 Preview-signalled rows on scc-2026-09-06, at different addresses. A list is a list of ids, so a list whose ids are gone is not a conservative list -- it is a no-op that reports success. These 19 are the rows that are actually there.
rulings: CF-BOWMANS-BEST-PREVIEW-IS-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT (Drew, 2026-09-06): the 20-card BBP1-BBP20 insert is its own product key `bowmans-best-preview`, in BOTH sports. The host it was packed out in (1997 Bowman) is provenance, not identity.

RESLUG, NOT RETIRE — and that is the change this revision makes to the shape as well as the ids. The prior revision retired because 'the correct destination key is the pending ruling, and a reslug onto a key nobody has ruled would mint a phantom product'. Drew has now ruled the key, so the destination exists and the rows can MOVE. A retire deletes and hands the row's sales to the rematch; a reslug carries the row and re-points its sales, which is strictly less loss when a correct destination is known.

THE NUMBER MOVES WITH THE ROW. Each row is re-addressed at `bbp<n>`, the number the card actually carries and the number every Preview sale in the pool is written with. The bare 1-20 it was minted at is Bowman's Best's own number space.

MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: no Preview row currently SHARES an address with a non-Preview Bowman's Best row (checked read-only, 2026-09-06 — 0 collisions among the 19). The number-space collision the incident created was closed by the fold lanes before this PR; what remains is 19 rows on the wrong PRODUCT, which is what this list moves.
EVERY TARGET IS VACANT. `bowmans-best-preview` holds ZERO catalog rows today, so no reslug can be refused for an occupied address. The lane refuses rather than merges if that ever changes.

THE CHECKLIST IS 20 CARDS AND ONLY 19 ROWS SURVIVE, unevenly across rungs (8 base, 5 refractor, 3 atomic, 3 stored with parallel 'Base'). This list does NOT invent the missing rows: the SCC re-mint does, from the source pages, which is why the re-mint runs FIRST. This list moves what is stored; it never mints.

THE 4,024 OTHER 1997 `bowmans-best` rows — the baseballcardpedia scrape and the proper Bowman's Best checklist — are NOT in scope. The 134 baseballcardpedia rows whose id carries a BBP number are the exploded card-BACK scrape (their `parallel` column holds player names, 'Promos' subset) and are a separate defect with a separate lane.
